intent: Independently validate exact-request calibration reuse, fixture reconstruction, frozen condition identity and resume integrity before boundary-calibration-02 execution.
implementation_author: coordinating /root agent; auditor did not author the runner or boundary proposal
scope: Calibration execution integrity. This audit does not adopt the proposed rubric clarifications or establish target-model conformance.

independent_reconstruction.method: Auditor rebuilt all fixtures from pinned prior source bytes and the proposal, reconstructed all condition requests with judgeMessages and requestFor, validated every manifest source/alias/endpoint, and recomputed the snapshot fingerprint. No provider calls were used.

verified: All 49 earlier fixture input/output pairs are loaded verbatim from SHA-256-pinned records. Their original pass/null and optional accuracy labels are checked before assembly; the 32 additions preserve the independently proposed, parent-reviewed labels.
The current and clarified conditions contain the identical 81 fixtures. Only the two proposed rubric texts differ; all other metric rubric bytes are identical across conditions.

Cache eligibility depends on the complete provider request and endpoint identity, never pass/fail, agreement, malformed output or error outcome. First matching sources follow frozen fixture order rather than favorable-grade selection.
The snapshot freezes each logical job's complete request, request hash, endpoint, selected prior source/path/hash or canonical job alias, and new-call designation before execution.

Current rubric pins are asserted; the fingerprint includes proposal, settings, endpoint, fixtures, exact rubric bytes, runner/evaluator/manifest dependencies, runner source, job manifest and worker count. Resume rejects any identity mismatch.
Prior, resumed and new response evidence must match the full request hash and endpoint. Existing rows are regraded with checkedResult and frozen labels; cached agrees flags are not authoritative.

An in-memory check confirmed a cached failing verdict remains a disagreement against positive gold, while malformed output cannot satisfy a negative gold fixture. Missing/error results remain visible rather than becoming agreement.
Identical unchanged requests are shared between conditions with explicit provenance. They are not reported as independent repeated provider calls.
The runner calls the judge transport only; it generates no tutor targets, changes no target output, and applies no valid-semantic-failure retry.
Sixteen-worker execution is explicitly frozen. Actual unique new calls and logical reused judgments are reported separately.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: The initial runner keyed reuse by request only, while the revised proposal also required endpoint/provider identity.
resolved_findings.resolution: Endpoint is frozen in the identity and every job; prior eligibility and resume/new-response validation require exact endpoint equality.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: The initial snapshot omitted the required per-job request, source/new-call selection and alias manifest.
resolved_findings.resolution: The full 162-job manifest is frozen before execution, with source SHA-256, full request/hash, endpoint and canonical aliases. Current rubric pins are also asserted.

remaining_limits: Fixture labels were proposed independently and reviewed by the coordinating agent; this audit does not invent a separate human label-approval event.
Any disagreement or evaluator error remains calibration evidence to diagnose. It does not authorize outcome-dependent resampling, relabeling, fixture removal or automatic rubric adoption.
Adoption of revised rubric bytes requires the declared calibration gates and comparable symmetric rejudging of affected checks on preserved target outputs, retaining historical judgments.
boundary-calibration-01 is an unrun superseded freeze and contributes no additional independent evidence.
The clear verdict applies to the inspected exact hashes and prepared boundary-calibration-02 snapshot; material changes require updated review.
